FR-3 exit 1 rule: measure/doctor.sh:22 holds the pattern `architecture check: [^ ]+ \(files=[0-9]+, findings=[0-9]+, parseErrors=[0-9]+\)`, and line 24 accepts exit 0 or an exit 1 with a whole-line `grep -qxE` match. grep -x is whole-line, grep without -i is case-sensitive, and each count requires [0-9]+. The grep sits in an if condition, so a no-hit returns 1 and does not abort under set -e.

Real CLI format and stream: packages/architecture-enforcement/src/architecture-check.ts:278 formats the line `architecture check: <status> (files=<n>, findings=<n>, parseErrors=<n>)`. architecture-check-cli.ts:127 writes it through writeProcessStdout, so the line goes to stdout. doctor.sh:15 captures 2>&1, so both streams reach the match.

No other FR-3 rule changed: git diff 6a059f1a..a284de0b0 -- measure/doctor.sh is 5 insertions and 1 deletion, all in the exit 1 condition and its comment. The exit 0 rule, the exit 2 drift rule, the other-code rule, and every printed string are unchanged.
